'''Norbert Herhammer''' (born 8 April 1975 in [[Rodalben]]) is a German politician serving as a [[member of the European Parliament]] since 2026.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.rheinpfalz.de/lokal/kaiserslautern_artikel,-herhammer-kein-doppelmandat-_arid,5896905.html|title=Herhammer: Kein Doppelmandat|work=[[Die Rheinpfalz]]|date=5 June 2026|language=de}}</ref> From May to July 2026, he was a member of the [[Landtag of Rhineland-Palatinate]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://landtag-rlp.de/de/parlament/abgeordnete/abgeordnetensuche/dr-norbert-herhammer-342|title=Herhammer, Dr. Norbert|publisher=[[Landtag of Rhineland-Palatinate]]|language=de}}</ref>
